Package org.bsc.langgraph4j.checkpoint

Record Class Checkpoint

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.bsc.langgraph4j.checkpoint.Checkpoint
public record Checkpoint(@NonNull String id, @NonNull Map<String,Object> state, @NonNull String nodeId, @NonNull String nextNodeId, @NonNull Instant createdAt) extends Record
Represents a checkpoint of an agent state. The checkpoint is an immutable object that holds an AgentState and a String that represents the next state. The checkpoint is serializable and can be persisted and restored.

Every checkpoint carries the creation date that can be used to order checkpoints reliably ( ie. by custom checkpoint savers ) even when the underlying storage doesn't preserve insertion order.

Since:
1.0.0

    • Checkpoint

      public Checkpoint(String id, Map<String,Object> state, String nodeId, String nextNodeId)
      Creates a checkpoint without an explicit creation date. The creation date defaults to Instant.now() truncated to millisecond precision, so a value that survives a round trip through a database ( most of which store milliseconds at best ) compares equal to the one held in memory.
      Parameters:
      id - the checkpoint id
      state - the checkpoint state
      nodeId - the node that produced the checkpoint
      nextNodeId - the next node to execute

    • updateState

      public Checkpoint updateState(Map<String,Object> values, Map<String,Channel<?>> channels, String nextNodeId)
      Returns a new Checkpoint with updated state and a new nextNodeId.

      The creation date is preserved because the checkpoint keeps its identity ( ie. the same id() ) and it is updated in place.

      Parameters:
      values - the partial state updates to merge into this checkpoint's state
      channels - the registered channels used to resolve and update values; may be null if values are already resolved
      nextNodeId - the identifier of the next node to execute; must not be null
      Returns:
      a new immutable Checkpoint; the original is unchanged
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if nextNodeId is null
      See Also:
      • AgentState.updateState(java.util.Map<java.lang.String, java.lang.Object>, java.util.Map<java.lang.String, java.lang.Object>, java.util.Map<java.lang.String, org.bsc.langgraph4j.state.Channel<?>>)
